blocks.text: Condo buildings in Sea Island
Burkeville — detached houses, not strata

Housing on Sea Island exists only in Burkeville: a pocket of single-detached houses on the south-east part of the island, built for aviation workers in three designs; the City of Richmond Archives states Burkeville is the only remaining population centre on Sea Island.
Where Sea Island sits
Drive time to Sea Island
Streets, schools and getting around Sea Island

items.t: Sea Island is a separate island in the Fraser River in the City of Richmond, BC — Lulu Island (the main part of Richmond) to the south and east, and the City of Vancouver across the North Arm to the north. "Sea Island" is both the board sub-area name and the City's own planning area 12 on the Official Community Plan Key Map, so the City name and the board name match.

Where the housing is: the island is dominated by Vancouver International Airport (YVR) on federal land; the only residential pocket is Burkeville, in the south-east part of the island near Miller Road and Russ Baker Way. There is no condo cluster anywhere on the island.

Main roads and bridges: Grant McConachie Way serves the airport terminals, Russ Baker Way runs south to the Dinsmore Bridge and Richmond, and Miller Road runs through Burkeville; bridges off the island are the Arthur Laing Bridge (to Vancouver), the Moray Channel Bridge, the Dinsmore Bridge and the No. 2 Road Bridge.
Transit: the Canada Line airport branch serves Sea Island at Templeton, Sea Island Centre and YVR-Airport stations, with a change at Bridgeport Station for Richmond–Brighouse branch trains.
Nearby areas: Bridgeport (Richmond, across the Moray Channel / Dinsmore Bridge), Terra Nova (Richmond, across the Middle Arm), and Vancouver (across the North Arm via the Arthur Laing Bridge).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Sea Island

items.t: Why this section still exists on a zero-stock island: the BC strata framework below governs any strata purchase in the province, and it is the framework a buyer would meet the moment any strata unit — residential or otherwise — were offered on Sea Island. The city and federal rules after it are the ones that actually shape Burkeville purchases.

Aircraft noise and height: federal Airport Zoning Regulations administered through Transport Canada set zoning in areas surrounding the airport, including maximum building heights; aircraft noise is managed through the YVR 2025–2029 Noise Management Plan, and the City's Aircraft Noise Sensitive Development (ANSD) Policy Area framework (City Bulletin DEVAPPS-05) applies to noise-sensitive development in the airport's vicinity — both are Burkeville purchase diligence, affecting additions, rebuilds and tree height as well as daily living.

Richmond property taxes: due once a year on the first business day of July — Thursday, July 2, 2026 — with a 5% penalty on any unpaid balance after that date and a further 5% penalty on balances still outstanding after September 1, 2026; this city-wide rule applies to Burkeville homes.

blocks.text: Good to know about Sea Island

items.t: The island's school is a museum stop, not a school. Sea Island Elementary School on Wellington Crescent has closed; the building survives as a Richmond Museum location, and Burkeville children are bused or driven off-island to their SD38 catchment schools.

The airport does not answer to City Hall. YVR states the airport occupies federal property within the City of Richmond, and the YVR 2037 Master Plan — approved by the federal Minister of Transport — governs airport land use. A buyer expecting City rezoning politics to shape the island's future is watching the wrong government for most of its land.

Federal zoning reaches into Burkeville backyards. The federal Airport Zoning Regulations cap maximum building heights in areas surrounding the airport so aircraft can operate safely — a live constraint on additions, rebuilds and even tree height on a Burkeville lot, checked through Transport Canada rather than the City.

Three Canada Line stations, no condo at any of them. Templeton, Sea Island Centre and YVR-Airport stations serve the island, but the station lands are airport/commercial — Sea Island is the rare SkyTrain-served sub-area where station proximity produces no strata stock at all.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Sea Island
Streets, schools and transit near Sea Island townhomes

items.t: "Sea Island" is both the board sub-area name as given (GVR board area) and one of the City of Richmond's own planning areas — planning area 12 on the City Official Community Plan Key Map — so the City name and the board name match.

The island sits in the Fraser River between Lulu Island (the main part of Richmond) to the south and east and the City of Vancouver across the North Arm to the north. Most of the island is Vancouver International Airport (YVR) on federal land; the only residential pocket is Burkeville, in the south-east part of the island near Miller Road and Russ Baker Way.

Where the housing stock is: only Burkeville — a pocket of single-detached houses built for aviation workers in three designs; the City of Richmond Archives states Burkeville is the only remaining population centre on Sea Island. There is no townhouse concentration to name.

Transit and roads: the Canada Line airport branch serves Sea Island at Templeton, Sea Island Centre and YVR-Airport stations, with a change at Bridgeport Station for Richmond–Brighouse branch trains. Grant McConachie Way serves the terminals, Russ Baker Way runs south to the Dinsmore Bridge, and Miller Road runs through Burkeville; bridges off the island are the Arthur Laing Bridge (to Vancouver), the Moray Channel Bridge, the Dinsmore Bridge and the No. 2 Road Bridge.

Schools: there is no operating public school on Sea Island — Sea Island Elementary School on Wellington Crescent has closed. School District 38 (Richmond) catchments are address-based and the district has no middle-school tier — elementary is Kindergarten to Grade 7 and secondary is Grades 8 to 12.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Sea Island

items.t: Why this section exists on a zero-stock island: there is no counted strata complex for the strata rules below to attach to today. They are stated because (a) a buyer who finds an apparent "strata" unit near the airport needs the test for whether it is residential townhouse stock at all, and (b) the Burkeville house purchase that is this island's actual product is governed by the fee-simple, City/federal and tax rules that follow. If a strata property is ever involved, review the strata documents under the provincial framework; BC strata disputes can go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal.

Form B diligence (any future strata purchase): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

Depreciation reports / CRF minimum (any future strata purchase): since July 1, 2024, strata corporations with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years, not deferrable by vote; since Nov 1, 2023, at least 10% of the annual operating budget must go to the contingency reserve fund.

Richmond Zoning Bylaw 8500, Official Community Plan Bylaw 9000, Flood Plain Designation and Protection Bylaw 8204. Sea Island is planning area 12 in the OCP framework for the Burkeville pocket, while senior governments are not regulated by the City OCP — airport-side changes follow the federal / YVR process under the YVR 2037 Master Plan, approved by the federal Minister of Transport.

Aircraft noise and height — the island-specific diligence: federal Airport Zoning Regulations administered through Transport Canada set zoning around the airport so aircraft can operate safely, including maximum building heights; aircraft noise is managed through the YVR 2025–2029 Noise Management Plan, YVR publishes annual noise reports with monitoring data, and the City's Aircraft Noise Sensitive Development (ANSD) Policy Area framework (City Bulletin DEVAPPS-05) applies to noise-sensitive development in the airport's vicinity. Check both before pricing an addition or rebuild on a Burkeville lot.

blocks.text: Good to know about Sea Island townhomes

items.t: Burkeville is a wartime housing pocket that outlived the war. Sea Island was once mostly farm land with small communities including Eburne and Burkeville; the Vancouver Airport opened on the island, and Burkeville — houses built for aviation workers in three designs — is the only remaining population centre.

The airport does not answer to City Hall. YVR occupies federal property within the City of Richmond, its land use follows the YVR 2037 Master Plan approved by the federal Minister of Transport, and the City OCP does not regulate senior governments — so the biggest neighbour's changes never appear on a City development tracker.

Federal zoning reaches into Burkeville backyards. Transport Canada's Airport Zoning Regulations cap building heights around the airport to protect aircraft operations — an addition, rebuild or tall tree on a Burkeville lot can be a federal question, not just a City permit question.

The everyday anchors are small and specific. Burkeville Park and the Sea Island Community Centre are at 7140 Miller Road; Larry Berg Flight Path Park is on Russ Baker Way; McDonald Beach Park is at the end of McDonald Road; Iona Beach Regional Park is at 900 Ferguson Road at the island's north-west end; and the Sea Island Conservation Area is a designated protected habitat named by YVR.
The nearest hospital is off-island. Richmond Hospital, 7000 Westminster Highway, Richmond (Vancouver Coastal Health).

blocks.text: Lots and land in Sea Island
Fee-simple lots

items.t: Housing on Sea Island exists only in Burkeville — a pocket of single-detached houses on the south-east part of the island, built for aviation workers in three designs; the City of Richmond Archives states Burkeville is the only remaining population centre on Sea Island. The documented form is freehold-style single-detached houses; the pocket is historic built lot fabric, not an offering.
Confirm the parcel's tenure and zoning with the City and, where airport lands are involved, the Airport Authority.
Serviced position, as stated: Burkeville homes are on City water and sewer services.

ALR vs non-ALR: Sea Island was once mostly farm land with small communities including Eburne and Burkeville, per the City Archives — history, not a current ALR finding. No current ALR parcel on Sea Island is confirmed; ALR status is a per-parcel check on ALC mapping, and no ALR percentage split is stated.

Flood position: Richmond is made up of low-lying islands in the Fraser River floodplain, protected by a perimeter dike system (49 km of dikes, 39 pump stations, designed for a 1:500 flood event, dikes being raised from 3.5 metres to 4.7 metres for sea level rise); the Flood Plain Designation and Protection Bylaw 8204 framework applies to new construction — confirm the lot's flood construction level with the City.

blocks.text: Federal airport land

items.t: YVR lands: most of Sea Island is federal airport land; the Vancouver Airport Authority states the airport occupies federal property within the City of Richmond. Land use at the airport is guided by the YVR 2037 Master Plan, approved by the federal Minister of Transport, and federal Airport Zoning Regulations administered through Transport Canada set zoning in areas surrounding the airport, including maximum building heights. Airport facility development follows that federal / YVR process.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and transit near Sea Island lots

items.t: Roads and bridges: Grant McConachie Way serves the airport terminals, Russ Baker Way runs south to the Dinsmore Bridge and Richmond, and Miller Road runs through Burkeville; bridges off the island are the Arthur Laing Bridge (to Vancouver), the Moray Channel Bridge, the Dinsmore Bridge and the No. 2 Road Bridge.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Sea Island

items.t: Sea Island is planning area 12 in the City Official Community Plan framework (City of Richmond 2041 OCP, Bylaw 9000) for the Burkeville pocket, while senior governments are not regulated by the City OCP — airport-side changes follow the federal / YVR process under the YVR 2037 Master Plan. Which regime governs a given parcel is the first diligence question on this island.

Most of the island sits under the YVR land use plan and federal airport zoning regulations rather than the City bylaw. Confirm the parcel's position with the City before pricing any rebuild, addition or split.

Federal Airport Zoning Regulations: administered through Transport Canada, they set zoning in areas surrounding the airport so aircraft can operate safely, including maximum building heights — they can affect additions, rebuilds and tree height on a Burkeville lot, and belong early in due diligence.

Aircraft noise: noise is managed through the YVR 2025–2029 Noise Management Plan, which includes work to promote compatible land use planning near the airport; YVR publishes annual noise reports with monitoring data. The City's Aircraft Noise Sensitive Development (ANSD) Policy Area framework (City Bulletin DEVAPPS-05) applies to noise-sensitive development in the airport's vicinity. Price the airport factor with that published evidence, not guesswork.

Flood / dike diligence — Bylaw 8204: the Flood Plain Designation and Protection Bylaw 8204 sets flood construction levels and dike setbacks; the island sits in the Fraser River floodplain behind the City dike system described in. Confirm the lot's requirements before planning a rebuild.

If a parcel is in the ALR: subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified. On ALR land the main house can be up to 500 m², a suite is allowed only inside it, and an extra residence can be up to 90 m² (186 m² on parcels over 40 ha). For farm class, BC Assessment looks for farm income of $10,000 a year on under 0.8 ha, $2,500 on 0.8 to 4 ha, and $2,500 plus 5% of the value of land over 4 ha; applications are due by October 31.

blocks.text: Good to know about Sea Island lots

items.t: The island's school is a museum entry, not a school: Sea Island Elementary School on Wellington Crescent has closed — its record sits with the Richmond Museum. Burkeville children are catchmented to schools on Lulu Island (7140 Miller Road → Brighouse Elementary / Richmond Secondary).

Burkeville's three house designs are a wartime aviation artifact: the pocket was built for aviation workers in three designs, and the Archives record that Sea Island was once mostly farm land with communities including Eburne and Burkeville before the airport took the island — the lot fabric a buyer walks today is that historic subdivision, not a modern plat.

The conservation lands are not future phases: the Sea Island Conservation Area is a designated protected habitat area named by YVR, and Iona Beach Regional Park (900 Ferguson Road) and McDonald Beach Park sit at the island's edges — amenity and habitat ground, not expansion land.
